content: HBS BattleTech: mech techs work one mech at a time so repair queue is serial and cumulative; refits up to ~30 days; one jump gives 2-3 weeks recovery; pilot injuries ~10 days each; 30-day upkeep cycle (salaries, maintenance, dropship fuel); contracts barely cover upkeep so a bad mission is financial ruin; 2-3 contracts per system to chain without traveling.
